description: This header file defines a generic typed vector data structure in C, including functions for initialization, allocation, clearing, freeing, reserving capacity, pushing, and popping elements.

methods.name: vector_<name>_init
methods.description: Initializes the vector by setting data pointer to NULL and sizes to zero.

methods.name: vector_<name>_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory for a new vector instance.

methods.name: vector_<name>_clear
methods.description: Clears the vector, releasing its elements via the release function if provided.

methods.name: vector_<name>_free
methods.description: Frees the vector structure and its data.

methods.name: vector_<name>_reserve
methods.description: Reserves capacity in the vector to accommodate additional elements.

methods.name: vector_<name>_push
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the vector.

methods.name: vector_<name>_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from the vector.
